mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 650 and industrial production (INDPRO) below 96.0 signal contraction in consumer demand and supply capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 650 and INDPRO < 96.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.08 signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS falls < 0.08.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 132,000 thousand over the past month signals weakening labor demand, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 132000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million and housing starts (HOUST) below 650 signal contraction in consumer and housing demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 400000 and HOUST < 650.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 signals deepening contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 94.0.
